source.bibliography: Arthur Edward Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911; text of the 1922 reprint).

upright.text_en: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.

upright.text_ja: 多くの意味を持つカードであり、読みのいくつかは調和させられない。私は、これを名誉と誠実さに結びつける読みを脇に置く。主な意味は単に圧迫だが、幸運、利益、あらゆる種類の成功でもあり、その場合にはそれらによる圧迫である。また偽りの外観、偽装、背信のカードでもある。人物が近づいている場所は、彼の運ぶ棒によって被害を受けるかもしれない。ソードの9が後に続くなら成功は無にされ、訴訟の問いなら確実な損失となる。
